description: Small fragment of an unknown nature. Very cursive hand and much faded. Dating: a partial Hijri date possibly appears in l. 6 of the recto: Shawwāl 1[...] AH, but it is less common for years to appear written out in this format (rather than with numerals). A date range of post-1592 CE (1[000] AH) does seem plausible, however, based on the paleography. Requires further examination. MCD.
description_he: שבר קטן בעל אופי לא ידוע. כתב מרוצץ מאוד ודהוי. מאוחר.
